items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I don't think I've seen that man in 40 years.

ctx.x: Tomorrow he doesn't, anyway. But after him and Celestan bust up, he went... He had his own band, huh? Had his own band.
Is he living or what? Yes, we saw him. He was at Pico's funeral. Yeah? Yeah, he was down there in front of the, uh...
at Blandin's that day. I don't think I've seen that man in 40 years. Ooh, been a long time since that day.
